newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Vilnius leads way as Lithuanian shares gain.
newsitem.headline: Vilnius leads way as Lithuanian shares gain.

text.p: Shares on the Lithuanian stock exchange gained on Thursday, with top bank Vilnius Bank leading the way, dealers said.
The A group index rose by 27.84 points to 1,378.67 and Vilnius Bank climbed to 143 litas from 140 litas on turnover of 125,480 litas.
Vilnius only returned to active trade yesterday after carrying out a split of its shares to 50 litas from 500 litas to make them liquid.
Vilnius Bank was also active on the bloc market with a trade worth 1.5 million litas passing through the market.
Fellow bank Hermis dipped to 144 litas from 145 litas on low trade of 57,600 and it was also actively traded in a bloc of 580,000 litas.
The total volume of bloc trades reached 5.2 million litas on Thursday, the highest for some time.
